text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The more heart-stirring the encounter, the 
quicker it seems to slip away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The moment I'm filled, it dries up, 
aches... and I crave it all over again."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu, casting her eyes down 
wistfully, looked just like a maiden 
yearning for love.
choice_data_list: (I should leave them be for now.)
Want to look back on the race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She stares at me looking thoroughly 
bewildered as to why I am here. It seems 
she had completely forgotten my presence.
choice_data_list: Let's keep this up next time too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Next—... That's right. For "us," there is 
a next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'll come see you again. My love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list:
Th-there are things you can gain by 
looking back, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If I close my eyes, I can remember it 
vividly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A flawless race. A dreamlike rendezvous...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For just a brief moment, seeing a dreaming 
girl beneath that bewitching smile, my 
heart was completely stolen away.
